title: AI Product Ad Templates for Photos and Videos | AIVideosUGC
description: Find AI product ad templates for photos and short videos. Choose a style, add one product photo, and get a new asset for your store or social feed.
h1: AI Product Ad Templates: See It, Recreate It, Launch It
lead: Get a product ad ready faster: pick a template, add your product photo, and download an asset for your store, social feed, or campaign.
card: Ready-made styles for product photos and videos. Pick one, add your product, and publish the next asset.

faq.q: What are AI UGC video ad templates?
faq.a: They are ready-made ad formats that place your product photo into a creator-style scene, product demo, or social post layout.

faq.q: How do AI UGC video templates work?
faq.a: Upload one clear product photo, choose a template, and review the generated asset before you post it.

faq.q: Why use AI-generated UGC ads instead of filming creators?
faq.a: Templates help you test new hooks and product scenes without booking a creator, studio, or reshoot for every version.

faq.q: Who are these templates designed for?
faq.a: They are for sellers, brands, and creators who need product assets for stores, social feeds, or paid campaigns.
Yes. Start with a clear product photo, pick a format, and download the result without editing experience.

faq.q: What industries are these templates suitable for?
faq.a: They suit beauty, clothing, food and beverage, home, jewelry, accessories, apps, and other product categories shown in the template library.

faq.q: Can I upload my own product images and videos?
faq.a: You can upload your own product image; the template starts from one photo, so a video upload is not required.

faq.q: Which platforms are these templates optimized for?
faq.a: Use the resulting assets on your store, social feed, or ad campaign, then choose the final spot and crop in the channel where you post.

faq.q: Are the templates free to use?
faq.a: Templates are included with a paid plan, and the current plans and credit allowances are listed on the pricing page.

faq.q: Can I use these video templates for commercial purposes?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads are cleared for commercial use and have no watermark, subject to the rules and claims for the platform where you publish.

faq.q: Why use templates instead of creating ads from scratch?
faq.a: A template gives you a starting structure, so you can spend your time choosing the product angle and testing versions instead of building every layout from a blank page.

m2.h2: How to Make Product Ad Templates in 3 Simple Steps

m3.h2: Pick a Product Ad Template for Your Next Campaign
m3.lead: Choose a template, add one product photo, and publish a fresh asset.

steps.d: Add one clear photo of the product you sell. A clean source keeps the item easy to inspect when you review the result.
Choose a template for the channel and buyer moment. The preview uses your uploaded item for a quick comparison before posting.
Download the asset when the product and framing look right. Add price or headline in your editor, then post it to your store or campaign.
